text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Wha—that's weird. I'm sure I heard a voice 
coming from here...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it ain't the statue of the Three 
Goddesses! The top of all Umamusume... 
wait, what was it again?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, if Fuji-san recognizes 'em too, they 
gotta be the real deal—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did you guys call for me? ...Haha, 
just kidding.
